subject: bio
title: Onion epidermis cells

parts.name: Cell wall
parts.function: The boundary of each cell; the walls make the brick-like pattern.

parts.name: Cytoplasm
parts.function: A thin layer pressed against the wall by the vacuole.

parts.name: Vacuole
parts.function: Fills most of each cell with cell sap.

parts.name: Nucleus
parts.function: One in each cell, pushed to the side by the vacuole.

alt_text: Four onion epidermis cells seen through a light microscope: brick-shaped cells, each with a thin layer of cytoplasm, a large vacuole and a nucleus at one side.
